public_definitions: The goal is to review the annual mortality surveillance dashboard and route the year that should receive peak-burden follow-up.
The chart reference is to use the yearly mortality trend to determine which reporting year warrants escalation.
The primary field label is 'Peak-burden year follow-up route'.
The options are: 'Escalate 2018 for annual mortality peak follow-up', 'Escalate 2010 for annual mortality peak follow-up', and 'Escalate chart for methodology reference review'.
